sentences.en: And by that, I mean you'll be able to play other players (PVP) to your heart's content without worrying about the guy who's forty levels higher than you wielding the ultra-rare Hammer of Thor.

sentences.en: This is a stratigy based PvP game in which you are the leader of an empire of solar systems.

sentences.en: The mechanism of association between hydroxy ethyl cellulose (HEC) and polyvinylpyrrolidone (PVP) has been studied by viscosity, UV, FTIR and DSC methods.
